name: Career Change Readiness Quiz
author: careerchangefinder.com (our own questions)
note: A self-check to help you plan. Not a scientific test and not financial advice.
instructions: Answer honestly about where you are today. Each answer earns 0 to 3 points.

scoring.method: Sum of points (0-30). Any question answered 0 or 1 adds its tip to your action plan.

levels.title: Plan first
levels.summary: A change is possible, but a few basics need work before you leave your current job.
levels.next_step: Pick the two tips below that matter most and work on them for the next 30 days.

levels.title: Getting ready
levels.summary: You have a good base. Close the gaps below and you can start applying or training.
levels.next_step: Set a date for your first concrete step, such as an informational interview or a course.

levels.title: Ready to move
levels.summary: You are well prepared to start your career change.
levels.next_step: Start applying, or enroll in the training your target job needs.

questions.text: If your income dropped during the change, how long could your savings cover your basic bills?
questions.tip: Build a cushion of at least 3 months of basic expenses before you leave your job, or plan a change you can make while still employed.

questions.text: Could you live on a lower salary for a while if your new career starts lower?

options.label: Yes, for up to a year
Yes, my target pays the same or more

questions.tip: Check the starting pay of your target job on its career page and write a budget for that amount.

questions.text: How many hours a week can you spend learning or job hunting?
questions.tip: Block out a fixed time each week, even 3 hours, and protect it like a work meeting.

questions.text: Do the people closest to you support this change?
questions.tip: Talk with your family or partner about the plan, the timeline, and any money changes.

questions.text: How clear is the job you want to move into?
questions.tip: Take the Free Career Test or use the Career Change Tool to narrow your options to 1 or 2 jobs.

questions.text: Have you talked to someone who already does that job?
questions.tip: Ask two people who do the job for a 20-minute informational interview about their typical day.

questions.text: Do you know which of your current skills carry over to the new job?
questions.tip: Use the Transferable Skills Finder to list the skills you already have for your target job.

questions.text: Do you know what training or credentials the new job needs?

options.label: Yes, but I have no plan yet
Yes, and I have a plan

questions.tip: Look up the education and certification section of your target career, then find a program near you through CareerOneStop.

questions.text: Do you have a plan for health insurance during the change?
questions.tip: Compare your options before you leave, such as a partner's plan, COBRA, or the Health Insurance Marketplace.

questions.text: Is your resume ready for the new field?

options.label: It's written for my current job
Yes, tailored to the new field

questions.tip: Rewrite your resume around the transferable skills your target job needs, not your old job title.
